## About
Gator Motorsport is a car dealer and service shop in Indianapolis. We sell new Lotus models like the Emira, Eletre and Emeya, and our pre-owned inventory consists of well cared for trades and hand selected vehicles. If you're selling, we specialize in consignment sales.
Our service garage takes all makes and models. We tune and upgrade suspension, set up tires and wheels, build and rebuild engines, and diagnose faults through a combination of visual, auditory, computer and on-road inspections. Then we lay out the options so you can decide.
Customers rate us 4.9 from 226 reviews on Google. Reviewers name Jonathon Kim and Ava Morgan in sales, Dan our Service Manager, and Owen from service.

## Services
- Pre-Owned Inventory: Well cared for trades and hand selected vehicles. Ask Jonathon or Ava for walk-around videos, a test drive, or a look at the car up on a lift.
- New Lotus: Explore the Lotus Emira, the Lotus Eletre and the Lotus Emeya, the fully electric Hyper-GT. Lotus parts are available too.
- Consignment Sales: We can help provide the audience and marketing to help sell your vehicle. One reviewer sold his Lotus Esprit through us and said we did exactly what we said we would do.
- Diagnostics & Repair: A full range of diagnostic and repair services regardless of make, model, or vintage, with a consultative approach and options to meet your needs.
- Alignment & Suspension: Alignments on the Hunter Hawkeye Elite, whose target sensors never come into contact with your wheels. For the track, we tune your existing suspension or add high performance components.
- Brakes: We assess, repair and maintain your entire braking system, and for track or race prepped cars we can upgrade it to handle added speed from power and suspension upgrades.
- Tires & Wheels: Help choosing the right wheels and tire compound, balanced on Hunter Engineering Roadforce equipment.
- Engine: From mild to wild: building, rebuilding, full engine conversions, internal modifications and external accessory components.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only service Lotus?
A: No. All makes and models are welcome in our service garage.

Q: Is there anything for first-time service customers?
A: Yes. On your first visit, you receive 15% off any single labor item.

Q: Do you have an alignment special?
A: Our service specials list alignments for $175. Additional charges could apply for custom specifications, and it does not include corner balance or ride height adjustment.

Q: Is an inspection included with service?
A: Yes. A free multi-point inspection is included with any service, and a Gator technician will review all inspection items with you.

Q: Does service work include a wash?
A: Yes. Any service work completed at Gator includes a complimentary hand wash.

## What customers say
- "My wife and I had been hunting for a very specific BMW for quite some time when we stumbled across a listing from Gator Motorsport on Cars.com. The car was perfect, and we found ourselves thumbing through the photos over and over. Between three kids and demanding careers, buying a car nearly 700 miles away felt like a stretch - until it became clear we wouldn't find "the" car locally.

I called Gator Motorsport and was greeted by Jonathon. I explained that I’ve spent over 20 years in automotive retail (fixed ops), and that I'd need solid assurances before traveling to Indianapolis. In my experience, the quickest way to tell if someone in this business is trustworthy is to mention that you're in the industry yourself. Jonathon’s attitude and tone didn't change a bit - he stayed warm, friendly, and offered whatever I needed to feel comfortable making the trip.

Within an hour, he texted me an exterior walk-around, an interior tour, and a cold-start video. He even had Owen from service plug in their Autel scanner on video to show me the readiness monitors and code history I’d asked for. The transparency alone sold me. The next day, we placed a deposit and booked our flights.

When we arrived at 9 AM a few days later, Jonathon had already moved the car from the center of the showroom to the exit bay so it was ready to drive. He handed us the keys and told us to take our time inspecting it. After a 30-minute test drive, Jonathon and Owen offered - without us even asking - to put the car up on a lift in the shop so I could check the undercarriage and look for leaks. The tech gave us plenty of space to look everything over while staying nearby for questions.

Back in Jonathon's office, the paperwork was ready and waiting. We signed, waited for the funds to transfer, and snapped a few quick photos for their Instagram with their social media manager (sorry I missed your name!) before starting the long trek home. The car was everything we hoped for.

I’ve seen the good and the bad in this business over the past two decades. I can't say I've ever had - or even been part of a company that offered - an experience as great as we had with Gator Motorsport. Your staff is incredible, and the passion is obvious the moment you walk in the door.

From the bottom of my heart, thank you for pushing to give our industry a good reputation. It’s inspiring to see that true enthusiasts still exist on this side of the desk." (Steven Hawk, 5/5)
